title: Cheeseburger Stuffed Bacon Wrapped Onion Rings
description: Bacon-wrapped onion rings stuffed with cheeseburger ingredients, glazed with Japanese BBQ sauce.

ingredients.item: Bachan's Roasted Garlic Japanese BBQ Sauce (2 tablespoons)

steps: Mix ground beef with shredded cheese, salt, pepper, and garlic to taste. Add bacon fat to keep the meat moist.
Slice onions into thick rings. Hollow out the center of each onion ring.
Form the ground beef mixture around each onion ring, shaping it to fit and hollowing out the center.
Wrap each stuffed onion ring with bacon slices.
Sprinkle with your favorite rub, then cook in a smoker or oven at 350°F for about 35 minutes.
Prepare the burger sauce by mixing all sauce ingredients together and chill until use.
Approximately 10-15 minutes before cooking is complete, baste the onion rings with Bachan's roasted garlic Japanese BBQ sauce to glaze.
Once cooked, cut open the onion rings, serve with the burger sauce for dipping.
notes:
Ensure bacon is wrapped securely around the onion rings to prevent unraveling during cooking.
